name: permission-primer
title: Permission primer
description: The soft ask before the browser's permission prompt: why you need notifications, camera, microphone or location, and what to do if blocked.
docs: kind picks the permission (notifications, camera, microphone or location), with its icon and words; benefit is one line on what the person gets. onRequest asks the browser and returns its answer; leave it out and the card asks the browser itself. state fixes the permission for a preview, or when you track it yourself; otherwise the card reads the browser (the Permissions API, or Notification.permission) and follows changes made in its settings. Not now is remembered in localStorage for snoozeDays (14) under storageKey. The browser's own prompt opens only from the Allow button, never on load, and the card is drawn after the page is live. If the browser closes its prompt without an answer, or cannot ask, the card says so (spoken too) and Allow takes the focus back. labels carries every word, including the steps shown when it is blocked.
